description_en: Queries the list of asset catalog entries. Online version: v6.1.0
description_zh: 查询资产目录列表，上线版本号：v6.1.0
kebab_example: aliyun dataphin-public list-catalog-assets --op-tenant-id 30001011 --list-catalog-assets-query AssetType=TABLE Keyword=abc PageNum=1 PageSize=10 QueryMode=EXACT_MATCH ShelveDirectoryIds=[1530129987573] Name=abc --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListCatalogAssets

parameters.help_en: The ID of the operator user
parameters.name: op_user_id

fields.help_en:
The asset type. Default value: TABLE. Valid values:
TABLE: tables, including views and materialized views.
INDEX: technical metrics.
BIZ_INDEX: business metrics.
API
PAGE: dashboards
fields.help_zh: 资产类型。默认为TABLE，枚举值：TABLE（表，包含视图、物化视图）、INDEX（技术指标）、BIZ_INDEX（业务指标）、API、PAGE（仪表板）
fields.name: asset_type

fields.help_en: The search keyword. Used when queryMode is set to ASSET_SEARCH. Supports keyword matching against the asset full name, asset name, asset display name, and asset description. If not specified, all assets are returned by default
fields.help_zh: 搜索关键词；queryMode=ASSET_SEARCH（模糊搜索）时使用，支持对资产全名、资产名称、资产展示名、资产描述做关键词匹配。不填默认查全量
fields.name: keyword

fields.help_en: The asset name. Used when queryMode is set to EXACT_MATCH. If not specified, all assets are returned by default
fields.help_zh: 资产名称；queryMode=EXACT_MATCH（精准匹配）时使用。不填则默认查全量
fields.name: name

fields.help_en:
The query type. Determines whether to use name for exact match or keyword for fuzzy search. Default value: EXACT_MATCH. Valid values:
EXACT_MATCH: exact match.
ASSET_SEARCH: fuzzy search
fields.help_zh: 查询类型；决定使用name精准匹配还是使用keyword模糊搜索。默认为EXACT_MATCH，枚举值：EXACT_MATCH（精准匹配）、ASSET_SEARCH（模糊搜索）
fields.name: query_mode

fields.help_en: The list of folder IDs to which the assets belong. Multiple folders are matched with OR logic. Only the specified folders are matched, and subfolders are not included
fields.help_zh: 归属目录ID列表；多个目录按或匹配，仅匹配指定目录，不包含子目录
fields.name: shelve_directory_ids

AssetFrom.description_en: The source of the asset. For TABLE (physical table), the value is returned in the format of "Dataphin-Workspace Type-Project Chinese Name (Project English Name)". For TABLE (logical table), the value is returned in the format of "Dataphin-Workspace Type-Data Domain Chinese Name (Data Domain English Name)". For TABLE (data source table), the value is returned in the format of "Source System Name-Data Source Name-Database/Schema Name". For INDEX (standard modeling metric), the value is the asset source of the associated aggregate table. For INDEX (custom metric), the value is the asset source of the source table. For API, the value is the data service project name. For PAGE, the value is the application system name
